name: hdie_host_cprxs_r1-r1-COMMIT
purpose: HBM die d4g host control plane on the static link endpoint (coordinator 0gd, lanes/OWNERS-HBM.md C2): successor of ot_hbm_host_cp_rx for host_N <-> hfd_ep_static <-> this tile; retires ot_hbm_lk_ep / ot_lkep_sub / ot_lkep_ctrl_phy_data / hfd_lk_ep_face / ot_hbm_host_phy_adapt and the on-die credit loop. Link sequencer (slot-calendar TX, one-frame RX pingpong drain), host link reliability (COLL static link capture with wrapping 16-b sequences), unchanged landing256 (2 SRAM), credit-free packet controller; 4 replay SRAM leaves.

bench.name: cprxs_mut1
bench.note: TX slot calendar one step late (frame on beat phase 4 / IDLE -> endpoint cal_fault)

bench.name: cprxs_mut2
bench.note: RX expect one edge early (link slot / sequence check -> epoch abort)

bench.name: cprxs_mut3
bench.note: no TX spacing (frames closer than the far one-frame pingpong recycle -> host endpoint early fault)

bench.name: cprxs_mut4
bench.note: rx word bit 40 flipped into the landing (configuration corrupted -> transaction mismatch)

bench.name: cprxs_mut5
bench.note: saturating link sequence counters (COLL behaviour): the session aborts at 65,536 frames
